items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I was the one that got him hooked up with that church... he was the minister up at 93rd and Broadway

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I was the one that got him hooked up with that church, with the church he's with. So he was the minister up at 93rd and Broadway...
I remember that, because I went to Max Roach and Abby Lincoln's wedding at that church, and he married them.
